question: can i use the photo lighting studio if im not in a photo class

body.answer:
Not necessarily. Use is restricted to students in specified photography courses; other CA courses may be approved case-by-case, as may Visual Arts majors and students who previously received training on the studio equipment. [1] Students should make reservations for the Lighting Studio (BC 140A). [4] Contact the Photography Lab about your eligibility.

**Photography Lab**: Phone: (201) 684-7235. Email: photolab@ramapo.edu. Location: Berrie Center 135. Eva Fazzari, Photography Lab Supervisor: Berrie Center 139; Lighting Studio: BC-140A. [33]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/photolab/lightingstudio/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/photolab/hours/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: whats the grad certificate in business foundations n is it online

body.answer:
The Anisfield School of Business Graduate Certificate in Business Foundations is designed for students who are not business majors and want to learn business fundamentals. It builds foundational knowledge in accounting, economics, marketing, finance, management, and business statistics; earning it requires six 2-credit courses (12 credits): ACCT 510, BADM 510, ECON 510, FINC 510, MGMT 510, and MKTG 510. [2][4]
Yes. All classes are taken entirely online, and courses are offered online in both fall and spring semesters. The certificate can be completed in one semester. [4][5]

**Anisfield School of Business**: Phone: Phone (201) 684-7379; Phone (201) 684-7380; Phone (201) 684-7378; Fax (201) 684-7957. Email: asb@ramapo.edu. Office: ASB-333. [15]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/graduate-certificate-in-business-foundations/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/graduate-certificate-in-business-foundations/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/graduate-certificate-in-business-foundations/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

answer:
The Anisfield School of Business Graduate Certificate in Business Foundations is designed for students who are not business majors and want to learn business fundamentals. It builds foundational knowledge in accounting, economics, marketing, finance, management, and business statistics; earning it requires six 2-credit courses (12 credits): ACCT 510, BADM 510, ECON 510, FINC 510, MGMT 510, and MKTG 510. [2][4]
Yes. All classes are taken entirely online, and courses are offered online in both fall and spring semesters. The certificate can be completed in one semester. [4][5]

**Anisfield School of Business**: Phone: Phone (201) 684-7379; Phone (201) 684-7380; Phone (201) 684-7378; Fax (201) 684-7957. Email: asb@ramapo.edu. Office: ASB-333. [15]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/graduate-certificate-in-business-foundations/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/graduate-certificate-in-business-foundations/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/asb/graduate-certificate-in-business-foundations/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

body.answer:
The IGG Bootcamp is a week-long summer program on Ramapo’s campus where students practice their IGG skills, work intensively on casework in a secure lab, learn as case roadblocks arise, and build connections with teammates. Students who complete the Ramapo College IGG Certificate Program may apply. [1]

The next Bootcamp is July 6–9, 2027. It costs $2,000, includes an on-campus dorm room and meals, and accepts a maximum of 15 participants. [1]

**Investigative Genetic Genealogy Center**: Email: igg@ramapo.edu. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/igg/bootcamp/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

answer:
The IGG Bootcamp is a week-long summer program on Ramapo’s campus where students practice their IGG skills, work intensively on casework in a secure lab, learn as case roadblocks arise, and build connections with teammates. Students who complete the Ramapo College IGG Certificate Program may apply. [1]

The next Bootcamp is July 6–9, 2027. It costs $2,000, includes an on-campus dorm room and meals, and accepts a maximum of 15 participants. [1]

**Investigative Genetic Genealogy Center**: Email: igg@ramapo.edu. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/igg/bootcamp/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: where do nursing students do clinicals

body.answer:
It depends on the program. Accelerated and generic nursing students spend much of their clinical time at The Valley Hospital. Other affiliates include St. Joseph’s Regional Medical Center, Hackensack Meridian Health Network, New Bridge Medical Center, Valley Home Care, Township of Garfield, Bergen County Department of Public Health, and other local community agencies. Students provide their own transportation to clinical sites. [7][8] Clinical placements for the accelerated program are scheduled in New Jersey within a 60-minute radius of campus. [11] RN-to-BSN students complete clinical requirements at various hospitals and clinical settings throughout the state; a traditional clinical experience is not required in that program. [6] Faculty select and monitor clinical facilities; other facilities may be used depending on course objectives and students’ learning needs. [5]

- **Transportation Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: shuttle@ramapo.edu. [15]

Often referred to as “practicum,” clinical experiences are authentic learning opportunities that connect theory with practice and seamlessly integrate with your teacher education coursework. question: applying to the accelerated nursing program do i need to send transcripts if i went to ramapo

body.answer:
If you are a graduating Ramapo College student or alum, you do not need to submit your transcripts for the accelerated BSN application. You only need to submit and upload to your application: one letter of recommendation, a current resume, and ATI TEAS Exam results. [5] The Nursing Programs Office page also says current or former Ramapo students who have not completed a non-Nursing Bachelor’s or Associate’s Degree at Ramapo or elsewhere are not eligible for the Accelerated BSN Program at this time. [6]

**Nursing Programs Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7749. Location: Adler Center for Nursing Excellence 215. [14]

Sources: [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/nursing/accelerated-bsn/application-instructions/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/nursing/accelerated-bsn/faqs/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

answer:

question: is there a nursing honor society

body.answer:
Yes. Sigma Theta Tau International, Ramapo College chapter, is the honor society of nursing. It recognizes students with outstanding achievements in nursing; students are invited to apply once they earn a GPA in the Nursing sequence. [14] The club directory lists Sigma Theta Tau as an Honor Society: [https://archway.ramapo.edu/SigmaThetaTau/](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SigmaThetaTau/). [5]

question: does the ms in accounting get me to 150 credits for the cpa

body.answer:
Yes. The catalog says the Accounting MS (Master of Science) in combination with an undergraduate degree provides the 150 credits required to sit for the CPA examination [1]. The program is 30 credits and is designed to build on an undergraduate accounting degree to meet the 150-credit requirement for New Jersey CPA certification [2].

Yes. The catalog says the Accounting MS (Master of Science) in combination with an undergraduate degree provides the 150 credits required to sit for the CPA examination [1]. **Graduate Admissions**: Phone: (201) 684-7270. Email: graduate@ramapo.edu. Location: McBride House. [13]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/dmc/programs/msds/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)
